fields.Name: T238 - Agent Mention Autocomplete
fields.Description: Triggers the agent-mention composer plugin and mention-autocomplete overlay — a distinct interaction from plain text submit, exercising the '@' trigger path only.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Chat application via the app switcher, wait for the workspace, and start a new conversation so the composer is focused. In the message composer, type an '@' character. Confirm a mention autocomplete popup appears listing selectable agents (names, possibly with icons). Optionally type a letter after '@' to see the list filter. Seeing the agent mention picker appear is success — you do NOT need to actually send a message. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing '@' in the composer opens a mention autocomplete dropdown/popup
The popup lists one or more agents to choose from (or a clear 'no matches' state after filtering)
The popup is anchored to the composer and dismisses when clicking away or pressing Escape
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
